name: Plastic bar supplier · three sizes
collection: Long game flight plans and strategies
author: Factorio Command Center

notes: Inputs are recipe ingredients and recognized machine fuels or fluids supplied from outside. Outputs are products not consumed by another included process. Check belt, pipe, and robot connections in-game; this analysis does not simulate routing or throughput.

Supply every labeled operating input, including fluids where listed, and external electricity. Preserve stock controls, circuit wires and passive-provider chest limits. Intermediates are manufactured inside; construction materials are not operating inputs.

Official 2.1.24 Space Age; 10 chemical plants (plastic bar), no modules, red belts, fast, long-handed and bulk inserters, pipes and pipe-to-ground, one substation. WEST: coal 600/min on the belt at (0,6) (either lane); petroleum gas 12,000/min into the pipe at (0,0), the top-left corner, from the west. EAST: one red belt exit at (16,5), 1,200 plastic bars/min (600 on each lane). Supply electricity at the substation.
Belt the exit east to the plastic entrances of the consumers. The exit tile holds 8 bars when nothing takes them (4 per lane in use), and every plant then stops.
Feed coal and gas at or above the panel figures; extra coal backs up on the entrance belt and extra gas stays in the pipes.
